Write {"file_path":"D:\Astrophotography\raw\M31\July 2026\rename.sh","content":"#!/bin/bash
# Sequential rename of FITS files across 6 night folders.
# Renames highest-to-lowest within each folder to avoid collisions.

BASE="D:/Astrophotography/raw/M31/July 2026"
DRY_RUN="${1:-true}"  # pass "false" as first arg to actually rename

declare -a FOLDERS=("Night 1" "Night 2" "Night 3_1" "Night 3_2" "Night 4_1" "Night 4 _2")
declare -a COUNTS=(17 1225 353 923 152 1060)

offset=0
for i in "${!FOLDERS[@]}"; do
  folder="${FOLDERS[$i]}"
  count="${COUNTS[$i]}"
  dir="$BASE/$folder"

  if [ "$offset" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "=== $folder: no rename needed (offset=0) ==="
    offset=$count
    continue
  fi

  echo "=== $folder: renaming $count files, offset +$offset ==="
  echo "    Range: img-$(printf '%04d' 1)..img-$(printf '%04d' $count) -> img-$(printf '%04d' $((1+offset)))..img-$(printf '%04d' $((count+offset)))"

  for (( n=count; n>=1; n-- )); do
    old=$(printf 'img-%04d.fits' "$n")
    new=$(printf 'img-%04d.fits' "$((n + offset))")
    if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "true" ]; then
      [ "$n" -eq "$count" ] || [ "$n" -eq 1 ] && echo "    $old -> $new"
    else
      mv "$dir/$old" "$dir/$new"
    fi
  done

  offset=$((offset + count))
done

echo ""
echo "Total files across all folders: $offset"
if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "true" ]; then
  echo "(DRY RUN - no files were changed. Run with 'false' to execute.)"
else
  echo "Done! All files renamed."
fi
"}

Write {"file_path":"D:\Astrophotography\raw\M31\July 2026\sequential-rename.sh","content":"#!/bin/bash
# Sequentially rename img-NNNN.fits files across subfolders.
# Folders are sorted by creation date (oldest first).
#
# Usage:
#   sequential-rename.sh [directory] [--run]
#
#   directory   Base directory containing subfolders (default: current dir)
#   --run       Actually rename files. Without this flag, dry run only.
#
# Examples:
#   sequential-rename.sh .                          # dry run, current dir
#   sequential-rename.sh "/d/Astro/M31/July 2026"  # dry run, specific path
#   sequential-rename.sh . --run                    # execute renames

set -euo pipefail

BASE="${1:-.}"
DRY_RUN=true
[[ "${2:-}" == "--run" ]] && DRY_RUN=false

# Collect subfolders sorted by creation time (birth time on NTFS)
mapfile -t FOLDERS < <(
  for d in "$BASE"/*/; do
    [ -d "$d" ] || continue
    btime=$(stat -c %W "$d" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -z "$btime" ] || [ "$btime" = "0" ]; then
      btime=$(stat -c %Y "$d")
    fi
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$btime" "$d"
  done | sort -n | cut -f2
)

if [ ${#FOLDERS[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "No subfolders found in $BASE"
  exit 1
fi

echo "Found ${#FOLDERS[@]} folders (sorted by creation date):"
echo ""

offset=0
total=0
for dir in "${FOLDERS[@]}"; do
  name=$(basename "$dir")
  count=$(find "$dir" -maxdepth 1 -name 'img-*.fits' | wc -l)

  if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "=== $name: no img-*.fits files, skipping ==="
    continue
  fi

  max_num=$(ls "$dir"/img-*.fits 2>/dev/null | sed 's/.*img-0*\([0-9]*\)\.fits/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)

  if [ "$offset" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "=== $name: $count files (img-0001 to img-$(printf '%04d' "$max_num")) — no rename needed ==="
    offset=$max_num
    total=$((total + count))
    continue
  fi

  new_start=$((1 + offset))
  new_end=$((max_num + offset))
  echo "=== $name: $count files ==="
  echo "    img-$(printf '%04d' 1)..img-$(printf '%04d' "$max_num") -> img-$(printf '%04d' $new_start)..img-$(printf '%04d' $new_end)"

  renamed=0
  for (( n=max_num; n>=1; n-- )); do
    old=$(printf 'img-%04d.fits' "$n")
    [ -f "$dir/$old" ] || continue
    new=$(printf 'img-%04d.fits' "$((n + offset))")
    if $DRY_RUN; then
      if [ "$n" -eq "$max_num" ] || [ "$n" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "    $old -> $new"
      fi
    else
      mv "$dir/$old" "$dir/$new"
    fi
    renamed=$((renamed + 1))
  done
  echo "    ($renamed files)"

  offset=$new_end
  total=$((total + count))
done

echo ""
echo "Total files: $total"
echo "Final range: img-0001.fits to img-$(printf '%04d' $offset).fits"
if $DRY_RUN; then
  echo ""
  echo "DRY RUN — no files changed. Add --run to execute."
fi
"}
